children: MIND TECHNOLOGY, INC reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $5.62M and a net loss of ($1.73M), or diluted EPS of ($0.19), versus revenue of $13.56M and net income of $1.93M, or EPS of $0.24, in the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Sales of marine technology products”. ² Reported as “Net (loss) income”. ³ Reported as “income per common share - Basic and diluted”.
Revenue decline driven by timing of large orders; quarter revenue was $5.6M versus $13.6M a year earlier, and YTD revenue fell to $15.3M from $21.5M.
After‑market activity increased as a share of revenue (85% of quarter revenue versus 66% prior year), partially offsetting fewer system sales.
Expansion of the Huntsville, TX facility is complete; repair and production have resumed and are expected to increase future capacity.
Firm backlog decreased to about $4.8M from $13.9M (Jan. 31); the company cites a sizable pipeline but uncertain timing for orders.
Near‑term demand remains weak amid geopolitical uncertainty; the company is pursuing product development and market diversification including wind, carbon capture and maritime security.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
